# Currena — Indicators & data sources (the consolidated reference)

**Live site:** https://currena.ir · **Live Insights API:** `GET /api/insights`
**Last refreshed:** this document is regenerated by hand on each round; the
single source of truth for live values is the `/api/insights` snapshot.

This document is the **single consolidated reference** for: (1) the
indicators Currena carries, (2) where each one is fetched from and how
often, (3) the public JSON API and its "free forever?" status, and (4)
the gaps the audit found. It supersedes the older `INDICATOR_INVENTORY.md`
and the per-round specs that drove each wave (both removed in the
2026-10-28 tidy-up — git history is the backup).

---

## 1. What indicators Currena has — the 102-indicator dashboard

The Insights page renders **102 indicators** across **2 sections** (Global
79, Australia 23 — see the
breakdown below), grouped under **9 question gauges** (5 global + 3
australia + the prices-board strip). Of those, **48 are scored voters**
(contribute to a gauge's verdict) and **54 are context rows** (live value +
10-year position bar, never vote).

The live snapshot is served at `GET /api/insights` — 102 `readings` plus
the two summary lines (Global and Australia). Each reading carries its
current value, the data date (`asOf`), the 7-day and 30-day changes, the
**10-year percentile position** (`percentile10y`), the **10-year z-score**
(`sd10y`, used by A-9/A-10's SD-based thresholds), the moveScore, the
distance from the 10-year peak, the source name + URL, and the verdict
status (`normal` / `warning` / `stale` / `unavailable` / `context`).

## 2. Where they get updated from, and how frequent

### The cron schedule (all times UTC, the account's free 5-cron budget)

| Worker | cron trigger | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **currena-api** | `* * * * *` (every minute) | The minute-cron's hour+minute gates dispatch the Insights ingest rungs (below) + the ever-green rates ladder (TGJU every ~5 min, Frankfurter every 15 min) + the hourly :13 prices-live refresh. |
| **currena-markets** | `30 23 * * 1-5` (Mon–Fri 23:30) | The world stock markets board — main fetch (EODHD-first, 16 indices). |
| **currena-markets** | `30 1 * * 2-6` (Tue–Sat 01:30) | Markets retry rung (Yahoo fallback for failed/old markets). |
| **currena-markets** | `50 8 * * 2-6` (Tue–Sat 08:50) | Markets Asia-session-finality rung (final closes). |

### The Insights ingest rungs (the currena-api minute-cron's hour+minute gates)

| UTC time | rung | what runs | subrequest budget |
|---|---|---|---|
| **04:10** | `main` | collect every source (FRED bulk groups — SEVEN since the Session-3 trio split: the nominal full-history pair, DFII10's own cosd=2003-01-02 request, and the five decade-window groups — + ECB + BoE + NBS + Frankfurter + World Bank + gold-api + Yahoo + ABS + RBA + Bitstamp + Alternative.me), derive, validate, write the snapshot + status + public projection + archives + stage. The real-yield scoring input carries the counted DGS10−T10YIE cross-fill (realYieldFill in the report; the stored history stays pure DFII10). | ~49/50 |
| **04:20** | `rung2` | The rung-2 phase — MOF jgbcme.csv (jgb-10y daily) + the daily-history-ALPHA phase (the 04:25 split, see below). One subrequest (MOF) + the stage read + ~4 writes. | ~8 |
| **04:25** | `history-daily-a` | Daily-cadence history writes (half A — the wave-3 split fixed the exceededCpu death). ~24 ids × 1 unconditional write each. | ~25 |
| **04:27** | `history-daily-b` | Daily-cadence history writes (half B). ~23 ids × 1 unconditional write each. | ~24 |
| **04:40** | `history-periodic` | Monthly/quarterly/per-change/manual ids — read-compared writes (only on change, ~once a month each). | ~26 reads + rare writes |
| **Saturday 04:25** | (within the daily phase) | +2 fetches: EIA crude stocks + CFTC gold positioning | ~+2 |
| **First-of-month 04:20** | (within the rung-2 phase) | +3 fetches: OECD CLI + GPR + EPU + their history reads | ~+8 |
| **10:10 / 20:10** | `sweep` | Gated re-runs of the full ingest ONLY when the last status shows fetch failures or is >10h old. Heals transient blips within hours; near-zero cost on healthy days. | ~1 KV read on healthy days |

| **yahoo** (Yahoo Finance, unofficial) | L2 (owner-accepted) | No reuse licence offered (unofficial endpoints) | Brent gap-fill (BZ=F), 10y gold/silver/BTC history, FTSE 100 | free, owner-accepted | no |

| **cftc** (Commodity Futures Trading Commission) | L0 | US government work — public domain | cftc-gold-positioning (Commitments of Traders, futures-only, deafut.txt) | **free forever**, keyless | no |

| **gpr** (Caldara-Iacoviello GPR index, hosted by Federal Reserve Board) | L0 | Academic open data, attribution displayed | gpr-index (Geopolitical Risk Index, monthly .xls) | **free forever**, keyless | no |
| **epu** (Baker-Bloom-Davis EPU) | L0 | Open academic data, licence quoted from inside the workbook | epu-us (US Economic Policy Uncertainty, monthly .xlsx) | **free forever**, keyless | no |
| **alternative-me** | L0 | Free API — attribution next to the data | crypto-fng (Crypto Fear and Greed) | **free forever**, keyless | no |

| **treasury** (U.S. Department of the Treasury) | L0 | US government work — public domain | FRED-fallback fills for DGS2/DGS10/DGS30/DFII10/T10Y2Y (fetched only when a FRED bulk group fails) | **free forever**, keyless | no |

### KV writes — the free-tier budget

The free Cloudflare Workers KV plan allows **100,000 reads/day**,
**1,000 writes/day**, and **50 subrequests per Worker invocation**. The
Insights page's serve path performs **exactly ONE KV read per request**
(`insights:snapshot`). The ingest rungs use:

- **04:10 main**: ~48 subrequests, ~26 KV writes (snapshot + status + public
  projection + archives + stage + the small set of periodic histories).
- **04:20 rung2**: ~8 subrequests, ~4 writes.
- **04:25 + 04:27 daily-history split**: ~24 + ~23 writes (idempotent —
  content-deduped).
- **04:40 periodic**: ~26 reads, rare writes (only on monthly/quarterly change).
- **Daily writes total**: ~50–60 KV writes — far under the 1,000/day cap.
  The 10:10/20:10 sweeps stay near-zero on healthy days (one KV read each).

## 3. The public JSON API — specification and "free forever?"

### The endpoints (the currena-api Worker, `https://currena.ir`)

| method | path | description | auth | rate limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/health` | Liveness probe — `{ ok, service, version, kv, time }` | none | none |
| `GET` | `/api/rates?source=tgju\|frankfurter` | The fallback ladder — the converter's source rates | none | 60/min/IP |
| `GET` | `/api/convert?from=USD&to=IRR&amount=100` | Server-side conversion math (via `@currena/core`) | none | 60/min/IP |
| `GET` | `/api/status` | Per-source status + cache age (the `/admin` pill reads this) | none | none |
| `GET` | `/api/insights` | The 102-indicator Insights snapshot (the canonical call) | **public by owner decree** (2026-10-19) — see below | none |
| `GET` | `/api/insights/:id/history` | One card's history (downsampled to ≤2700 points) | public (the L2 sources are bounded to the visible chart window) | none |
| `GET` | `/api/insights/markets` | The world stock markets board (16 indices, EODHD-first) | public (owner directive 2026-10-18b) | none |
| `GET` | `/api/insights/fx` | The world currencies board (10 pairs + 7 patterns, ECB rates) | public (owner directive 2026-10-21c) | none |
| `GET` | `/api/insights/status` | The Insights ingest status (last fetch row results, generatedAt) | public | none |
| `GET` | `/api/insights/archive/:date` | One historical archive (the `insights:archive:v1:<date>` family) | public (read-only) | none |
| `POST` | `/api/insights/login` | Owner login — sets the HMAC cookie session | n/a | 5/min/IP |
| `POST` | `/api/insights/mode` | The owner's runtime mode switch (`ACCESS_MODE=public\|private`) | owner cookie + `INSIGHTS_OWNER_TOKEN` | 5/min/IP |
| `GET` | `/api/insights/export?format=md\|csv\|xlsx` | The owner-only full export (every reading + every history) | owner cookie + `INSIGHTS_OWNER_TOKEN` | 5/min/IP |
| `POST` | `/internal/refresh` | The header-secret scrape trigger (the ever-green ladder's manual override) | `REFRESH_SECRET` header | none |
| `GET` | `/admin` | The zero-JS ops console (noindex) — per-source status + manual refresh | `ADMIN_VIEW_SECRET` cookie (if set) or public | none |
| `GET` | `/robots.txt` | `Disallow: /admin` | none | none |
| `GET` | everything else | The built SPA (static assets + SPA fallback for deep links) | none | none |

### The `/api/insights` shape

```jsonc
{
  "generatedAt": "2026-10-26T04:20:17.883Z",
  "summary": {
    "global":     { "section": "global",     "label": "stressed", "warningCount": 9, "votingCount": 32, "excludedCount": 0 },
    "australia":  { "section": "australia",  "label": "stressed", "warningCount": 7, "votingCount": 16, "excludedCount": 0 }
  },
  // Gold Program (optional field — absent on snapshots written before it):
  // the gold-directional re-cut of the voters (GOLD_SCORE_SPEC.md — 21
  // voters since the D-5 promotion: breakeven-tilt votes for gold while
  // staying a context card for its own gauge). Compact numbers only; the
  // SPA re-derives the firing-driver list client-side through the same
  // pure engine.
  "goldSummary": {
    "netScore": -1,                        // tailwind voters − headwind voters
    "label": "headwind",                   // strong-tailwind | tailwind | balanced | headwind | strong-headwind | null
    "firingVoters": 3, "tailwindVoters": 1, "headwindVoters": 2,
    "laneCounts": { "tailwind": 1, "headwind": 2, "mixed": 0 },   // of the four lanes
    "subGauges": [                         // exactly four, in lane order
      { "lane": "borrowing-costs", "reading": "tight", "tailwindVoters": 0, "headwindVoters": 2 },
      { "lane": "dollar",          "reading": "strong", "tailwindVoters": 0, "headwindVoters": 0 },
      { "lane": "stress",          "reading": "mixed",  "tailwindVoters": 1, "headwindVoters": 0 },
      { "lane": "inflation",       "reading": "hot",    "tailwindVoters": 0, "headwindVoters": 0 }
    ],
    "modelVsReality": {                    // the score vs gold's actual 30-day move
      "chip": "diverging-up",              // aligned-tailwind | aligned-headwind | diverging-up | diverging-down | neutral | no-read
      "modelDirection": "headwind",
      "realityDirection": "rising",
      "realityBasis": "change30d",         // or ma200GapPct (the fallback) / null
      "realityValue": 5.2                  // the signed percent the reality read
    }
  },
  "readings": [
    {
      "id": "yield-curve-10y3m",
      "value": 0.78,
      "asOf": "2026-10-23",
      "change7d": -0.04,
      "change30d": 0.05,
      "percentile10y": 0.46,           // 10-year position (0..1)
      "sd10y": -0.06,                   // 10-year z-score (for A-9/A-10's SD thresholds)
      "moveScore": 1.37,
      "fromPeak10y": -1.32,             // distance from the 10-year peak (percent)
      "lastChange": { "date": "2026-10-23", "points": -0.08 },
      "status": "normal",               // normal | warning | stale | unavailable | context
      "sourceName": "Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis via FRED (T10Y3M)",
      "sourceUrl": "https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/T10Y3M",
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-26T04:20:17.883Z"
    },
    // ... 101 more readings, in lane order
  ],
  "calendar": [ /* the release-schedule events */ ],
  "notes": [ /* the live context notes (off by default) */ ]
}
```

### "Free forever?"

**Yes — for the data, the API, and the hosting, with one operational caveat.**

1. **The data sources** (§2 above): every one is **keyless and free** — FRED,
   ECB, BoE, MOF, NBS, RBA, ABS, Frankfurter, World Bank, gold-api, EIA,
   CFTC, OECD, GPR, EPU, Alternative.me, Treasury, Yahoo (unofficial
   endpoints — owner-accepted), Shiller (open academic). The only paid
   source on the account is **EODHD** (the markets worker's world stock
   board) on the owner's personal plan — and even that's a free personal
   tier. **No Insights indicator depends on a paid source.**
2. **The API surface**: every public Insights endpoint (`/api/insights`,
   `/api/insights/:id/history`, `/api/insights/markets`, `/api/insights/fx`,
   `/api/insights/status`, `/api/insights/archive/:date`) is **free and
   unauthenticated** for any reader. The owner-only routes (`/export`,
   `/mode`, `/login`) sit behind the owner cookie + `INSIGHTS_OWNER_TOKEN`.
3. **The hosting**: Cloudflare Workers + Workers KV on the **free plan**.
   The 50-subrequest-per-invocation ceiling, the 1,000-KV-writes/day cap,
   and the 100,000-KV-reads/day cap are all respected (the daily write
   count is ~50–60; the serve path is exactly one KV read per request).
   The only operational caveat: the **GitHub Actions runner minutes
   exhausted** on 2026-10-20 (the `insights-ingest.yml` workflow fails
   at runner allocation ever since), so the **Worker's own minute-cron
   owns the ingest** since then — the GHA workflow stays as belt-and-
   braces (its writes are idempotent; if GHA recovers, both venues
   write the same bytes). No paid plan is needed for either.
4. **The owner-decree**: the Insights page is **public** (the
   `ACCESS_MODE=public` setting, owner directive 2026-10-19). The T-15
   build gate verifies that `data/site-mode-overrides.json` hides every
   source that is not `publicDisplayOk: yes` — currently **zero hidden
   indicators** (the L2 citation-required class is display-permitted
   with attribution per the FRED legal page read 2026-10-21; the L2
   Yahoo/Shiller/EODHD legs carry owner directives lifting their
   worst-leg display bar).

## 4. Possible gaps — the audit's findings (2026-10-26)

The 2026-10-26 gap audit reviewed every existing and proposed source. It
approved ten additions (all now live as A-1..A-10) and **rejected** the
rest with evidence. The rejected set is the standing "do not rebuild
unless a source revives" list — revisit quarterly.

### The ten approved additions — all shipped

| id | source | shipped? | live value @ deploy |
|---|---|---|---|
| A-1 `yield-curve-10y3m` | FRED T10Y3M | ✓ | 0.78 @ 2026-10-23, Normal |
| A-2 `jgb-10y` (upgrade) | MOF jgbcme.csv | ✓ | 2.837 @ 2026-10-23 |
| A-3 `us-japan-10y-gap` | derived (DGS10 − jgb-10y) | ✓ | 2.046 @ 2026-10-22, Normal |
| A-4 `gold-oil-ratio` | derived (gold-usd ÷ brent) | ✓ | 36.6 @ 2026-10-26, context |
| A-5 `rba-fed-gap` | derived (rba-cash − fed-mid) | ✓ | 0.725 @ 2026-10-23, Normal |
| A-6 `eia-crude-stocks` | EIA LeafHandler (keyless) | ✓ | 695.2m barrels @ 2026-10-16, context (pct10y 0% — record-low territory) |
| A-7 `cftc-gold-positioning` | CFTC deafut.txt | ✓ | 49.68% @ 2026-10-20, **Warning** (above the 45% crowded-long threshold on day one) |
| A-8 `oecd-cli-us` / `-cn` / `-de` | OECD SDMX (one fetch, three rows) | ✓ | USA 100.9993 / CHN 97.41035 / DEU 101.0066 @ 2026-09 |
| A-9 `gpr-index` | Caldara-Iacoviello .xls (the biff reader parses it) | ✓ (not blocked — the spec's possible BLOCKED never materialised) | 146.21 @ 2026-09, context |

### The rejected proposals — do NOT rebuild unless the source revives

These were proposed in the audit and rejected with live evidence. They are
**not** in the indicator set and **not** on the page; they're listed here
so a future owner can revisit if a source revives.

| proposal | why rejected (live evidence 2026-10-26) |
|---|---|
| **ICE BofA HY spread** (BAMLH0A0HYM2) | FRED's T-16 scan found the `pre-approval required` licence class — the publisher's written permission is required before any fetch or display. Fail-closed on both gates. |
| **ICE BofA IG spread** (BAMLC0A0CM) | Same pre-approval class as above. |
| **Cboe put/call ratio** | The free CSVs end at 10/04/2019 — frozen for ~7 years. |
| **WGC central-bank gold buying** | No login-free feed exists. |
| **PBoC policy rate** | No machine-readable feed exists. |
| **BIS API** | Returns HTTP 500. |
| **Daily German Bund** (the OECD mirror's daily upgrade) | The ECB Data Portal carries no national benchmark yields (only the euro-area AAA curve, which the page already uses daily); the Bundesbank API is dead; Eurostat not disseminated. The bund-10y card stays on the OECD monthly mirror with its honest "monthly average, lagged" label. |
| **Silver/Bitcoin ratio** | Fails the classic-indicator criteria (silver-btc was retired 2026-10-23 as the weaker twin of gold-btc). |
| **Silver/Bitcoin stays unbuilt; Gold/Bitcoin stays context-only** | Per the spec's standing rule: gold-btc is context-only, never voting. |

### Known operational gaps — status after the 2026-10-28 R10 round

1. **GitHub Actions runner exhaustion** (since 2026-10-20): the
   `insights-ingest.yml` workflow fails at runner allocation (free
   Actions minutes exhausted). The Worker's own minute-cron owns the
   ingest as the PRIMARY venue (verified live through the 04:10/04:20/
   04:25+04:27/04:40 rungs); the GHA workflow stays as belt-and-braces
   (documented inline with a `RUNNER EXHAUSTION` note in the workflow
   header). **Status**: documented; no code fix possible (billing).
   **Owner action**: none required — the Worker venue is the primary.
2. **The Cloudflare API token in git history** (surfaced 2026-10-26,
   R10-6 rotated the deploy token 2026-10-28): `context.txt` carried a
   live Cloudflare Workers API token. Removed from the tree in
   `5b74dde`; the token remains in git history. R10-6 put a FRESH
   token (`cfut_29Aaz…`, env-only) in service for deploys; the old
   token MUST still be revoked by the owner at
   https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens. The exact rotation
   steps are in `docs/insights/OWNER_SETUP.md` §10. **Status**: fresh
   token in service; **owner action required: revoke the old token +
   update the GitHub repo secret**.
3. **RBA venue block — all rba.gov.au paths now Akamai-blocked from
   the Worker** (R10-1, 2026-10-28): the R9 venue-verified baseline
   (2026-10-21: "the HTML cash-rate page is still served to Cloudflare
   Workers") is no longer true. As of 2026-10-27, Akamai 403s every
   rba.gov.au path (CSV tables AND the HTML cash-rate page) from the
   Worker's egress. The parser itself is verified correct against the
   current page shape (6 regression tests pin it against a saved
   fixture, `packages/insights/fixtures/rba-cash-rate-page.html`).
   The three RBA readings (au-10y, rba-expectations, au-us-10y-gap)
   stay stale at 2026-09-30 until either (a) Akamai relents, (b) the
   GHA minutes reset (monthly) so the GHA workflow_dispatch can re-
   fetch from GitHub Actions' different egress, or (c) the owner sets
   up a different ingestion venue. **Status**: parser regression-
   pinned; venue block is operational. **Owner action**: none until
   the block clears; the readings refresh automatically on the next
   successful RBA fetch.
4. **The jgb-10y OECD mirror's retirement clock**: the spec retires the
   FRED OECD jgb-10y mirror after two clean MOF weeks. The MOF upgrade
   went live 2026-10-26; the earliest honest retirement date is
   2026-11-09. The mirror stays as the labelled fallback until then.
   **Status**: time-dependent; no action possible until 2026-11-09.
5. **~~STLFSI false-positive stale flag~~** — **FIXED (R10-2,
   2026-10-28)**. Root cause: FRED STLFSI4's 2026-10-23 weekly release
   was missed upstream (the last obs is 2026-10-16); the 10-day weekly
   default flagged the 11-day-old reading stale, while NFCI (same
   date, same FRED bulk group) showed normal because of its
   `staleAfterDays: 14` override. Fix: added `staleAfterDays: 14` to
   `stress-stlfsi` (matching NFCI's precedent); +1 behavioral test
   pins the 14-day window. The live reading flips from stale to
   normal on the next ingest rung.
6. **~~The 16-failure briefing jsdom baseline~~** — **FIXED (2026-10-27)**.
   Root cause: the test fixture used a hardcoded `asOf: '2026-10-16'`
   which became stale (>5 days old per `STALE_DAYS = 5`) as real time
   passed. When all markets were stale, the component returned the
   collapsed stale shell (heading + "old; last update" message only),
   never rendering the radio buttons, movers, tiles, etc. that the 16
   failing tests expected. Fix: `vi.setSystemTime(new Date('2026-10-17T12:00:00Z'))`
   in `beforeEach` — freezes the clock so the fixture's 2026-10-16 dates
   are always 1 day old (never stale) and the staleSnapshot's 2026-09-01
   dates are always >5 days old (always stale). **All 696 web tests pass
   (was 680 pass + 16 fail). Full suite: 1955/1955 green.**
7. **The `insights:hist:cftc-gold-positioning` accumulation**: the COT
   file's first weekly point seeded the history on 2026-10-26; the second
   point joins on the next Saturday (2026-11-07). The single-point floor
   is the designed shape — no action needed. **Status**: time-dependent;
   no action possible until 2026-11-07.
8. **The global companies table (R10-3, 2026-10-28)**: the owner's R9-09
   directive (~50 world-leading companies below the markets tiles) is
   pre-built behind a feature flag (`COMPANIES_TABLE_ENABLED = false` in
   `apps/web/src/components/insights/config/companies.ts`). The typed
   ticker config (`packages/insights/src/companies/definitions.ts`), the
   EODHD adapter stub with zod contract (`adapter.ts`), 19 unit tests
   against fixtures, and the bilingual empty-state UI
   (`CompaniesTable.tsx`) are all in place. Zero live calls fire while
   the flag is off; no cron rung is wired. The flip is a one-line change
   when the owner upgrades the EODHD plan (the free plan's 20 calls/day
   quota is the blocker). **Status**: pre-built, flag OFF. **Owner
   action**: decide whether to upgrade the EODHD plan (~US$19.99/month
   entry tier), then flip the flag + wire the cron rung (the procedure
   is in the config file's header comment + `ROUND10_REPORT.md` R10-3).

### Quarterly review checklist (the spec's standing rule)

Every quarter, re-read the terms of every L1/L2 source and re-probe every
rejected source. The current cycle's reads live in `packages/insights/src/
licences.ts` (`SOURCE_LICENCES`) and `packages/insights/src/sources.ts`
(`SOURCE_RISK_REGISTER`).
